facts.fact: 全国赛雷雨日：Mugikura 警告"决心与恐惧只有一线之隔，别赌"，Strada 摇头抗议似听懂
facts.anchor: There’s a fine line between determination and fear

facts.fact: 投入清单：建赛场翻马厩、Shintani 双倍工资、训练加到每周五天——马的身心稳定、跳跃日进
facts.anchor: I’d started paying Shintani twice what I used to pay him

facts.fact: 她贴上马鼻感受热血与强意志——"我想赢，相信我"，必须让他跑
facts.anchor: I could feel Strada’s strong will through my fingertips

facts.fact: 昨日 Miu 翻遍十年档案问"这都是你做的？"——她微笑，内心默念：能当证据的都已销毁
facts.anchor: I’ve already disposed of anything that could possibly be considered evidence

facts.fact: Ushio 昨夜密语：公司要他发起调查，他一口咬定没什么可查——让她别担心
facts.anchor: but I assured them there was nothing to investigate

facts.fact: 他开始直呼其名，笑容如捕食者盯着猎物——"今晚我过去，我们聊聊"
facts.anchor: He looked like a predator eyeing its prey

facts.fact: 惊雷炸响：Strada 嘶鸣如尖叫、前腿扬起甩下 Shintani——头朝下摔进泥里一动不动
facts.anchor: a whinny that sounded like a scream echoed through the arena

facts.fact: 五百公斤马身撞上障碍架，三根硬管翻落缠住马腿——他摔进沼泽般的场地溅起泥浆
facts.anchor: three hard tubes from the hurdle tumbled down

facts.fact: 刚买的骑靴深陷泥中——她连鞋带袜脱掉赤脚奔向马
facts.anchor: I took off my shoes, and my socks with them, and ran to him barefoot

facts.fact: 她摸着颤抖的脖颈：听不到他的歌（平常像从她身体里发出），生命正从黑眼睛里迅速流失、身体越来越冷
facts.anchor: The life was quickly draining from his deep black eyes
